entities.name: German Occupation & the Holocaust
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: German invasion (July 1941), the Reichskommissariat Ostland, the Holocaust in Estonia (virtually all Estonian Jews murdered), Estonian SS conscription, and the desperate 1944 attempt to restore independence between retreating Germans and advancing Soviets.
